ambiguities: Odette's quoted line about le père du narrateur ("Il a été tellement bon, tellement exquis pour moi") and the narrator's follow-up reflection on her transfiguring rhetoric are treated as a single movement already captured by the accepted E1 (Odette's narrated elevation); the father has no distinct local outcome of his own beyond being the raw material for that elevation, so no supplement event was added for him.

The narrator's hand-kiss at the close of the passage ("je portai à mes lèvres la main qu'elle me tendait") is a staged action with Odette, but it is rendered almost entirely as internal hesitation and a "geste aveugle et insensé" rather than a clear social favor granted or withheld by another character, so it was judged too unstable in polarity/stance to score with confidence.
